A home battery backup with inverter is a system that stores electricity in batteries and converts it into household AC power (120V/240V) during an outage. Many systems can also integrate with solar panels.

There are two main options:

1. All-in-one home battery systems

These combine a lithium battery, inverter, battery management system, and backup controls into an integrated solution.

Shop

Tesla Powerwall 3

13.5 kWh battery capacity, integrated solar inverter, and up to 11.5 kW continuous power per unit. Suitable for whole-home backup with appropriate installation.

Shop

EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra

Modular battery and inverter system, starting at 6 kWh capacity per battery, with 120V/240V output and expandable storage.

Shop

Anker SOLIX X1

Modular residential energy storage with hybrid inverter capabilities, designed for solar integration and home backup.

2. Separate battery and inverter systems

They offer more flexibility for expanding capacity and selecting components, but require careful electrical design and compatible equipment.

chats.answer:
A home battery backup with an inverter stores electricity and supplies AC power to your home during a power outage. Some systems can also charge from solar panels and reduce electricity costs by using stored energy during peak-rate hours.

There are three main types of systems to consider:

Shop

1. All-in-one home battery with inverter

Examples: Tesla Powerwall 3 and Enphase IQ Battery 5P.

Integrated or manufacturer-matched battery and inverter systems, typically professionally installed. Good for automatic home backup.

Shop

2. Separate battery and hybrid inverter

Examples: EG4 inverter paired with LiFePO4 batteries.

More customizable and expandable. Often attractive for DIY-oriented or cost-conscious installations, though home wiring requires appropriate electrical work.

Shop

3. Portable battery with built-in inverter

Examples: EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3 and BLUETTI AC200L.

Convenient for appliances, refrigerators, computers, and temporary backup. Some can integrate with a home transfer system.
